lines: Orc
Hey! Drop dead!
Me
Ugh...
The Orc's powerful blow sent me flying, and my back, slammed against the wall, creaked.
With this many enemies, avoiding a fatal wound was all I could manage.
In a one-on-one fight I wouldn't be outmatched, but I'm surrounded by a horde of demons.
Me
(Damn, what a troublesome situation—)
It happened just as I was finishing a solo mission and about to head home.
They had nothing to do with my mission, but the others, suspicious of a human's presence, attacked as if seeking a grudge.
I tried to flee, but it turned out to be their territory; reinforcements kept arriving, and before I knew it I was in this situation.
Me
(...no time to look back now)
In front of me, completely surrounded, the massive Orc that had just punched me inched closer.
Orc
Heh heh, looks like you're at your limit? I'd spare a pretty sister, but a worthless guy like you isn't worth it—
Looks like this is it—.
Me
(I don't want to use that power here—but—)
If I get battered, play dead, and recover after they leave, I might manage to survive.
I considered using it offensively, but against so many foes the risk would be too great.
I need to make a shallow wound look severe enough to fake death without strain—.
Just as I was about to expose a opening,
Shishimura Koro
(...Fuma-kun, bow your head, okay?)
Me
Eh—Whoa!?
Reacting to the sudden voice, I lowered my stance, and a kunai whizzed past where my head had been.
It pierced the heads and chests of nearby foes, and several enemies collapsed in a heap.
Me
Koro-senpai!?
Shishimura Koro
(Looks like I made it in time, desu da yo)
Me
Desu da yo?
She uses an unfamiliar ending, but it's unmistakably Shishimura Koro-senpai.
Just—unlike her usual uniform, she was wearing a Chinese‑style dress, wielding a Chinese‑style sword, and even her movements were fitting.
Shishimura Koro
(That was for the part where he got beaten. Shall we call this a match?)
Orc
Hey, that's just as ordered... Capture this woman alive!
Shishimura Koro
(Hmm, this isn't worth talking about.)
Probably she didn't hear the senior's words.
The orcs changed color in their eyes at the sight of the beautiful girl and lunged to capture her.
And senior Koro met them with moves not of her usual Itō style but a kung‑fu‑like martial art mixed with Chinese boxing.
Shishimura Koro
(Ah… no, that's not right. I didn't say that.)
Mumbling something, she accurately kicked and elbowed at the opponents' vital points, while swinging her sword to cut a bloody path.
Me
Koro‑senpai, the right side… the alley is narrow, reinforcements are few…
Shishimura Koro
(Got it—yeah, that sounded right.)
She immediately cut through the right encirclement, and after the number of enemies decreased somewhat, she took my hand.
Shishimura Koro
(Looks like we can go now—can you run?)
Me
Of course…
Thanks to the brief rest, I could swing my sword a little.
Orc
Damn, you kids… Don't let them get away, kill them if you have to!
At the leader's shout, the demons swarmed after us, but with just the two of us it wasn't a problem.
Covering each other's blind spots we ran through, we somehow broke the encirclement and rushed into the dark alley…
Me
—If we made it this far, we should be fine.
Saying that I stopped and turned back toward senior.
Me
Thank you, Koro‑senpai.
Shishimura Koro
(Yeah, glad we're safe.)
Me
By the way, about that outfit—
First comes the question, but having just been rescued, I hesitated to ask…
Me
Um, it really suits you.
Shishimura Koro
(Is that so? Heh, thanks.)
While agreeing, the senior continued, as if she could read my mind.
Shishimura Koro
(I was just on a trip and just got back... The clothes are something I got from someone I met while traveling.)
Even though she had just returned from her trip, she was given this sudden rescue mission and came to help me.
Me
Th-Thank you... I really appreciate it. You were exhausted, yet you saved me.
Shishimura Koro
(…Mmm.)
As I thanked her, the senior gave me a look that seemed irritated.
Me
S-senpai?
Shishimura Koro
(…Aren't you curious about the person who helped you? Someone who would give a dress like this, and I'm happily wearing it?)
Why she suddenly became upset—
Probably she wants me to keep the conversation going with a question.
Me
Eh? Um… what kind of person?
To my question, the senior let out a sigh with a complicated expression and began to recount what happened on her trip.
She had gone to a certain town in a Southeast Asian country.
While enjoying sightseeing and shopping, she somehow got lost in a tangled alley and encountered a woman there.
The woman, dressed in a Chinese‑style dress like the one the senior is wearing now, was badly injured and seemed unconscious.
As she tended to the woman’s wounds, a group of strange men arrived.
Man
Hehe, there you are, fox lady. Shall we have you hand over the 'Leader’s inheritance' you stole?
Shishimura Koro
(What a bold one…)
The men with drones appeared to be soldiers of some organization.
Not understanding their words, the senior’s eyes fell on the folk‑art‑like item the woman was carrying.
Shishimura Koro
(Is this it…? Ah—)
The moment she casually touched it, her technique—Soul‑Communication, the ability to converse with souls—automatically activated.
It was the soul of a middle‑aged man—an ethereal spirit—apparently residing in that folk art piece that spoke to us.
A nervous‑looking man with a tiny moustache under his nose supposedly pleaded with the senior.
Chobi
(Sorry, but could you help us? This isn’t just our country’s problem—it's a world‑wide crisis.)
Shishimura Koro
(I feel like I’ve seen that guy’s face somewhere… maybe?)
And so the senior teamed up with that spirit and the rescued woman, throwing herself into the fight to protect the folk art.
As thanks, the woman gave the senior a dress matching her own design.
Shishimura Koro
(That’s why I wore this when I returned home, so I showed up like this…)
Me
“I see… but what’s with that tone?”
Shishimura Koro
(Your English has a weird charm… but I thought it was cute, hehe.)
After the incident, the senior became good friends with the woman.
While she showed me around town and taught me martial arts, I apparently picked up her way of speaking.
It seems the senior, the spirit, and that woman secretly saved the world.
Me
(—Or rather, that tiny moustache… never mind. I don’t want my wild guesses to cause confusion.)
As we talked, we passed a rough‑looking district and found ourselves on the main street of the bustling downtown.
Shishimura Koro
(Still, that was a close call. I’m glad Fuuma‑kun made it out okay… ha.)
The senior smiled brightly while biting into a steamed bun bought from a street stall.
Me
“Sorry, that’s all I can offer as thanks.”
Shishimura Koro
(Right. Next time something more lasting would be nice… a ring or a necklace?)
Me
“I… need to check my allowance first…”
Shishimura Koro
(Hehe, just kidding. If I got something like that, Tsuruchan would get really angry.)
Saying that, the senior split the bun and held out a piece.
Shishimura Koro
(yes, ahh~♪ Fuma-kun also try eating?)
Me
Thanks...
It looked like it broke as soon as I put it to my mouth, but I pretended not to mind.
Me
Senpai, do you travel often?
Shishimura Koro
(Yeah. You get to meet all kinds of people.)
The “various people” she mentioned weren’t all living partners like women in dresses.
Be it the little‑bearded spirit or the souls of the dead, to her they were all beings she could actually interact with.
Shishimura Koro
(There are souls consumed by darkness, but most of them are watching over loved ones or wishing happiness for the ones they loved—)
Shishimura Koro
(Many of them have such warm feelings. I want to touch those feelings, understand them… and pass them on to someone.)
Of course, that also means resolving the lingering regrets of spirits, but what she really means is that it’s not just that.
Even if not, if we could understand people’s warm hearts and spread them widely, the world would be filled with more kindness.
Even if it’s idealistic—senpai’s feelings are noble.
Me
As expected of you, senpai… I respect you. I couldn’t ever imitate that.
Shishimura Koro
(I don’t think that’s true… Ah. If you want, maybe next time… go together?)
Me
Eh—
Stunned by the unexpected invitation, I froze and stopped in my tracks.
But when I imagined the scene under senpai’s gaze, the journey seemed wonderfully beautiful.
Shishimura Koro
(No?)
Me
—No, not at all. I’d be honored to go with you.
Without any pretense or concern, that reply just slipped out naturally.
I was surprised myself, so senpai was probably shocked to hear such an answer.
But senpai immediately narrowed her wide eyes into a smile.
Shishimura Koro
(...hehe, thank you. If you say it like that, we’ll definitely go… I’m looking forward to it.)
Me
Me too.
This is a token of our promise—
Senpai ripped the half‑bitten meat bun and shoved it into my mouth.
